caption.text:
Polda Metro Jaya kembali melakukan penggeledahan terkait kasus dugaan korupsi. Kali ini, polisi menggeledah ruko yang berlokasi di kawasan Cipete, Jakarta Selatan (Jaksel).⁣
Informasi penggeledahan ini dibenarkan oleh Kabid Humas Polda Metro Jaya Kombes Budi Hermanto. Polisi tiba sekitar pukul 23.15 WIB. Terlihat juga petugas menggunakan rompi bertuliskan 'Kortas Tipikor'.⁣
⁣
Polisi memasang garis polisi di depan ruko. Mobil inafis berwarna oranye juga terparkir.⁣
⁣
"Benar (ada penggeledahan)," kata Budi Hermanto kepada wartawan, Kamis (9/7/2026).⁣
⁣
Penggeledahan masih berlangsung hingga pukul 00.17 WIB, Jumat (10/7).⁣
⁣
#detiknews #penggeledahan #kasuskorupsi
caption.text_translation:
Folda Metro Jaya again conduct investigation in connection with alleged corruption case. This time, the police searched the ruku located in Cipete area, South Jakarta (Jaksel).
This exploration information is authorized by Kabid Publica Metro Jaya Kombes Budi Hermanto. Police arrived around 11:15 pm. It was also seen that the officers were using a vest written 'Kortas Tipikor'.

Police put up police lines in front of ruku. Orange Inafis car is parked also.

"It's true (there's a search)," Budi Hermanto said to reporters, Thursday (9/7/2026).

The search is still ongoing until 00.17 pm, Friday (10/7).

 #detiknews #penggeledahan #kasuskorupsi
